title: Signing a Request for a HECM Modified Tenure or Modified Term Plan
content:
When a borrower of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) asks to move the line onto lifetime or fixed-term monthly payments while keeping in the line only what Cedarline requires, the borrower's own signed payout plan change request names a Modified plan and designates the designated amount, the most of the line Cedarline lets the borrower commit to the payments on the handling date.

**Timing.** The designated amount is not worked out until the most recent prepaid portion that restored nothing to the line when it was applied carries its line restoration entry. Until that portion carries its line restoration entry, no designated amount is worked out.

**The amount on the request.** For a change into a Modified plan the committed amount is the requested amount on the request, which may not exceed the available line after any release, otherwise the request is declined with the reason insufficient available line; for a request signed for the designated amount, and only for it, the requested amount is the designated amount, the available line less the amounts kept in the line, which never exceeds that available line.

## Signing the request: `sign_payout_plan_change_346bec33`

A borrower-owned action: the agent unlocks `sign_payout_plan_change_346bec33` and hands it over, and the customer themselves signs and submits it as a signed written request. One call files one new request naming the payout plan wanted, the term in months for a term-based plan and the amount of the line the borrower designates to fund monthly payments, dated today and waiting for processing; the loan itself does not change.

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `hecm_loan_id` | Reference number of the borrower's HECM loan, as returned by the HECM loan lookup for that borrower. |
| `customer_id` | Customer reference number of the borrower signing the request, as returned by the customer profile lookup. |
| `requested_plan` | Exactly one of: "HECM Line of Credit" (draws only, no monthly payments); "HECM Tenure Payment Plan" (equal monthly payments for as long as a borrower lives in the home, the whole line committed); "HECM Term Payment Plan" (equal monthly payments for a fixed number of months, the whole line committed); "HECM Modified Tenure Plan" (lifetime monthly payments funded by a designated part of the line, the rest kept as a line); "HECM Modified Term Plan" (monthly payments for a fixed number of months funded by a designated part of the line, the rest kept as a line); "HECM Fixed-Rate Single Disbursement" (the closed-end fixed-rate plan, which no adjustable loan can move to); `not_applicable` (no plan change; applies only to requests that are not plan changes, so never the right value here). |
| `requested_term_months` | Number of monthly payments wanted for a term-based plan, an integer count of months; 0 for a plan that is not term-based. |
| `requested_amount` | Amount of the line designated to fund the monthly payments of a Modified plan, in US dollars with exactly 2 decimal places; 0.00 for any other plan; stored as given, rounded half up to the cent. |

**Return.** A sentence beginning "Plan change request signed" gives the new request reference (beginning "hpc_"), the loan reference, the plan requested, the term in months, the designated amount with 2 decimals, the channel signed written, the request date (today) and the status submitted; it means the request is on file. Afterwards the borrower can quote the reference, and the request shows as submitted until processed.
